geopolitics_summary: EU sanctions on Russian LNG (effective 2027) and COP31 climate diplomacy signal hardening climate policy, but EU climate chief hints pragmatism on electrification may temper ambition.

themes.headline: Russia redirects Arctic LNG away from Europe from 2027 onwards
themes.why_it_matters: EU LNG import ban forces Russian volumes to Asia via longer, costlier routes. Tightens Atlantic arbitrage, reduces LNG supply to NW Europe; supports TTF and power forwards as alternative gas sources become scarcer.

themes.headline: EU methane regulation delayed amid industry lobbying complaints
themes.why_it_matters: Delay in methane rules reduces near-term pressure on gas supply-side costs and emissions compliance. Softer climate enforcement prolongs cheaper (dirtier) gas availability; suppresses EUA upside and power spreads.

themes.headline: EU climate chief hints pragmatism on clean power electrification targets
themes.why_it_matters: Signal of eased EU electrification ambition at COP31 suggests slower renewable build-out and power demand growth. Reduces structural tailwind for power prices and RES-based generation capacity expansion.

themes.headline: U.S. natural gas storage ends injection season above five-year average
themes.why_it_matters: Elevated US gas storage (3,810 Bcf, +2% vs. 5-yr avg) eases LNG export availabilty and suppresses US gas prices. Increases LNG export capacity to Europe; lowers TTF via transatlantic arb pressure.

themes.headline: EU Court upholds climate laws against Poland's legal challenges
themes.why_it_matters: Judicial reinforcement of EU climate framework credibility. Strengthens EUA floor expectations and support for carbon-intensive plant retirement; supports power price via higher implicit carbon costs.

watchlist: COP31 final text on methane, electrification and fossil fuel language (outcome effect on EUA, power demand narrative)
Russian LNG supply reroute to Asia (Jan 2027 onwards – monitor transatlantic LNG arb and TTF seasonality)
EU methane rule implementation timeline (regulatory clarification expected Q4 2026 / Q1 2027)
US weekly gas storage drawdown pace (monitor rate; impacts LNG export volume to Europe through winter)
